This is a classic presentation of **acute, self-limited gastroenteritis**: abrupt onset (2 hours), prominent upper GI symptoms (nausea, vomiting, cramps) alongside diarrhea, absence of systemic or inflammatory markers (normal WBC, no fever, normal electrolytes, negative blood cultures), and no red flags.
